result:
I’d make empathy a prerequisite for power. Anyone with political, economic, or technological authority would have to understand the real human consequences of their decisions—not as an optional concern, but as the foundation of the system.

Much of the world’s harm comes from people and institutions being able to reduce others to numbers, costs, or problems. If power required empathy, cruelty would become far harder to institutionalize.
